note: A plain-writing rewrite (Dan, 20 Oct: teach in your own words, no talk of where things come from, few footnotes). The figures are unchanged from the case file's lesson 6 entries, each re-checked by hand.
validator: draft 1: case.json and the lesson (with --case) validate with no problems, soft or hard. Six footnotes in the words ([^13] Cmin, [^26] 14.82 mΩ/m, [^29] 1.28, [^32] 0.87 Ω, [^48] the 0.4 s scope, [^55] Table 41.5), each alone in its sentence; the other sources stay as data on the numbers.

faults.finding: 'An earth fault opens the breaker only if enough current flows' is untrue: below Ia a breaker may still open on its thermal part, only too late.
faults.fix: 'opens the breaker in time only if enough current flows'.

faults.finding: 'Most faults clear much faster' goes past the point that these are maximum times, not actual times.
faults.fix: 'They are the longest times allowed, not how long it will take.'

faults.finding: 'the same check as the fault current against Ia' drops its verb; 'taking a practice 0.15 Ω at DBP2' trails as a clause.
faults.fix: 'the same as checking the fault current against Ia'; the practice value in its own short sentence.

faults.finding: 'Those were cut short partway' is vague.
faults.fix: 'Those figures were rounded down partway through. The pass is the same.'

checked_and_sound: Refresher pattern intact: recall with its two slips and Refresh the why / Skip to the practice (screen 7); what it is for with the red consequence; the why with its interactive (run length, conductor size, hot/cold switch); a judgement check; when Zs is too high (four ways out, the bonding debate as debated); the worked heater line by line with the cut-short figures noted; Section A 2(a) and 2(b) with scenario, carried parts and typed answers; two Section B written answers, five points each, any three; one changed-numbers item; Keep this. Twelve screens.

No source talk in the words: no 'your slides', page numbers, 'a trade guide', 'a forum answer' or 'the course's own'. Assumptions said once, plainly ('Assume the motor is fed from DBP2 …'), practice values said simply wherever they bear on a figure.
Every screen that asks him to act (drag, work each step, pick, type) has a Read sentence that stands without controls.
BS 7671 tables not reproduced: one value each with its table; Table 41.5's values with 'check both in your copy'; the 25 A type B figure 'read the real figure from Table 41.3'.
